findings.observation: A validator adding an unpinned file on its third invocation reaches one fake transport call before the post-executor validation rejects the file.
findings.fix: Repeat the complete regular-file inventory and hash check after each validator.

findings.observation: Evidence hashes and completion receipt did not require the callback evidence files and nested directories to be fsynced first.
findings.fix: Sync every exact evidence file and directory before completion, recheck identities/inventory/hashes, and terminate on sync errors or observed drift.
